_doc: Warrior subclasses (docs/plans/warrior-subclasses.md). The chosen subclass is the PC string attribute "subclass", wiped at remort. Skill bans and gains are <subclasses> nodes in each skill XML (node named after the subclass: <level> gives the skill, <level>-1 bans it), read by C++ GenericSkill. This file holds what Fenia reads (dreamland_fenia utils/subclass): the gates of the choice (profession, level, min/max race size from .tables.size_table, minimum trainable stat caps) and the weapon rules of the subclass skills (an off-hand weapon must fit too): weapon_classes = any weapon of these classes, banned_classes = never these, damage_types = the weapon must deal one of these damage types (.tables.damage_table), banned_flags = never a weapon with one of these flags (.tables.weapon_type2), one_handed = no two-handed weapon, shield = a shield must be worn, no_shield = no shield may be worn, single = no weapon in the off hand (a held item is fine), dual = a second weapon must be wielded. The engine (dreamland_code onehit_undef.cpp) also reads berserker weapon_classes and dual, at every hit, for the blood frenzy band. A subclass missing here gives no gains through its weapon rules, and its skills refuse with weapon_refusal.

blood_frenzy._doc: The frenzy makes armor worse by ac_pct percent of the berserker's current armor class (its absolute value, the average of the four, the rage penalty already in), nothing when the armor is no better than none, scaled by how well blood frenzy is learned. Ends with berserk.

bladestorm._doc: cooldown in seconds between two spins. Every swept target takes one normal blow from each hand; every blow costs move_per_hit moves, and the storm stops when the moves run out.

weapon_refusal.en: This takes a sword or an axe in each hand.
weapon_refusal.ru: Для этого нужен меч или топор в каждой руке.
weapon_refusal.ua: Для цього потрібен меч або сокира в кожній руці.

feint._doc: The target's parry, dodge and shield block against the fencer drop by feint effective / div for secs seconds (2 rounds).

riposte._doc: After a parry with the fencer's sword: one plain thrust with chance riposte effective / chance_div (luck counts), at most one per cooldown seconds.

taunt._doc: For secs seconds the target's hitroll drops by skill level / hit_div and its parry by parry points, both x cur_cha / cha_base of the fencer. A tier mob aims its focus moves at the fencer.

lunge._doc: skill_one_hit divisor (damage x (level / dam_div + 1)) and accuracy bonus of the opening thrust.

weapon_refusal.en: This takes one thrusting sword in hand, no shield and no second weapon. Not a katana.
weapon_refusal.ru: Для этого нужен один колющий меч в руке, без щита и без второго оружия. Не катана.
weapon_refusal.ua: Для цього потрібен один колючий меч у руці, без щита й без другої зброї. Не катана.

con_scale._doc: Thorns damage and the counterbash double-charge chance grow with current con above base, up to cap: scale = min(cur_con, cap) - base, 0..8.

counterbash._doc: A successful shield block adds a charge, up to max. A block with max charges fires a free bash with the shield and empties them. bonus_pct: chance per point of con scale that one block adds two charges. The charges are an affect of duration ticks, renewed by every block, so they fade out of combat.

thorns._doc: Damage to the attacker on a block: dice(skill level / dice_div, dice_size) x (8 + con scale) / 8, never lethal. shrug_pct: base chance (attacker's luck counts) to take none.

phalanx._doc: A one-handed spear and a shield: shield block chance + block_bonus (and its cap with it), thorns x thorns_pct / 100.

shield_throw._doc: cooldown in seconds between two throws; away = seconds after a throw with no shield block; targets = enemies hit at most; daze_div = the first target is dazed with chance skill / daze_div.

weapon_refusal.en: This takes a shield on your arm and a one-handed weapon that is not a polearm.
weapon_refusal.ru: Для этого нужен щит на руке и одноручное оружие, не алебарда.
weapon_refusal.ua: Для цього потрібен щит на руці й одноручна зброя, не алебарда.
